look: XORA site look, same as the V00 welcome film: deep void ground, frosted glass panels with thin cyan-to-violet edges, fictional market lines drawing in, calm eased motion, the brain tutor guiding from the bottom-right corner

scenes.name: Lesson seventeen
scenes.desc: Title card: Phase 4, lesson T17, support, resistance, breakout, fakeout; the tutor walks in.

scenes.name: The same two areas
scenes.desc: A fictional sideways chart keeps turning near the same high and low areas.

scenes.name: Support
scenes.desc: Support defined; a floor analogy; price tests the 59,800–59,900 area three times and bounces.

scenes.name: Resistance
scenes.desc: Resistance defined; a ceiling analogy; rallies stall near 60,350 twice.

scenes.name: Zones, not lines
scenes.desc: Three lows at 59,830, 59,860 and 59,880 miss a single line; a 100 USDT zone fits them.

scenes.name: Breakout
scenes.desc: A candle closes at 60,480, 80 USDT above the 60,300–60,400 zone; a retest holds.

scenes.name: Fakeout
scenes.desc: Same history, other ending: the wick reaches 60,460 but closes at 60,350, then price falls back.

scenes.name: What counts as confirmation
scenes.desc: Three observations: a close beyond the zone, follow-through, a retest that holds; never certainty.

scenes.name: Common mistake
scenes.desc: Exact lines and wick-chasing versus zones, closes and WAIT.

scenes.name: Try it
scenes.desc: Pause: a wick to 60,450, close 60,380, zone top 60,400. Confirmed? Not yet; WAIT.

scenes.name: Thin liquidity
scenes.desc: Few waiting orders: one larger buy jumps price through the zone and it snaps back.

scenes.name: Know the limits
scenes.desc: Lines are history, fakeouts are common, thin markets distort, WAIT is allowed.

scenes.name: Recap
scenes.desc: Three key points and one question to check yourself.

scenes.name: Up next
scenes.desc: End card: next lesson T18, volume, volatility and range.
